The [b]Latam Spanish[/b] translation of FixFox is ready—thanks to the amazing [b][url=https://translators-tale-team.itch.io/]Translators' Tale Team[/url][/b]! 🌎✨

Now we need your help with the final step: LQA (Localization Quality Assurance). If you'd like to play through the game and help us polish the translation before its official release, join our community effort!

💡 This is a volunteer opportunity with no financial reward—just a chance to help make FixFox shine for even more players.

🧡 Your feedback will make a real difference.

🔧 Interested in helping? Drop by our [url=https://bit.ly/FixFoxDiscord]Discord[/url] or leave a comment below!

Gracias y nos vemos en el espacio!

notes.title: Antonblast Release
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42990367/9d3568d4c479ef6da9104f71bc4279613e228cb4.png[/img]

The wait is finally over. After a very successful Kickstarter in 2022 and 100,000 wishlists later, Antonblast has been released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887400/ANTONBLAST/

[b]ANTONBLAST [/b]is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged [b]Dynamite Anton[/b] (or his cranked-out coworker [b]Annie[/b]) and use your [b]Mighty F’n Hammer[/b] to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your [b]Spirits [/b]back from [b]Satan[/b]!

That's right: Satan himself has stolen Anton's prized Spirit collection, and he'll stop at nothing to get it back. Thankfully, the local disgraced casino owner, Brulo, has his own beef with Satan, and he's willing to put aside his differences with Anton to make that devil pay.

Your mission in every level is simple: [b]SET [/b]Brulo's Detonators, [b]FIND [/b]Anton's Spirit, and [b]ESCAPE [/b]before Happy Hour ends!
[list]
[*]     [b]BLAST [/b]through a unique powertrip of a platformer!
[*]     [b]INDULGE [/b]in an urban graffiti-inspired art style!
[*]     [b]DEMOLISH [/b]massive destructible environments!
[*]     [b]BATTLE [/b]brutal, earthshaking bosses!
[*]     [b]EXPERIMENT [/b]with a totally dynamic playstyle; rush through for the best time or explore at your own pace!
[/list]


[h1]FEATURES[/h1]

[list]
[*]     [b]Shock and Awe![/b] Unlike other platforming heroes, Anton's not content to stay in his lane. Jet between the foreground and background layers for 2.5d platforming action!
[*]     [b]Destructible Everything![/b] Use Anton's mighty hammer to break down your environments!
[*]    [b] Hurry Up! It's Happy Hour![/b] Once Anton gets to the end of a level, set off the Spirit Detonator and dash back to the start before everything blows!
[*]     12 unique sprawling worlds with tons to explore!
[*]     Dynamic play style - rush to the end or explore at your own pace!
[*]     Silky smooth platforming gameplay with best-in-class controls!
[*]     Breathtaking hand-drawn animation!
[*]     Brutal earthshaking bosses!
[*]     A groovy, retro-flavored dynamic soundtrack!
[*]     Loads of replay value: Hard Mode, Boss Rush, and more!
[/list]
https://youtu.be/IYqE7h1YNUA?si=Y1q6RAqWK7fWW_Fb

notes.title: Spanish (European) translation released
notes.notes:
🎉 We're thrilled to announce that FixFox is now available in Spanish (European), all thanks to our amazing community volunteers! 🎉

To enjoy FixFox in your preferred language, simply restart Steam to get the latest update, then head to Settings to change the language. Happy exploring!

A huge shoutout and round of applause to these incredible translators for their hard work and dedication. 🌟👏

[b]Spanish (European):[/b]

- Zam

notes.title: Community Translation
notes.notes:
When making FixFox, accessibility was always one of my priorities.
And one of the things that I feel still needs addressing is language variety. 
There are players that can't enjoy FixFox because of a language barrier. The game is ready for it, the localization system is in place. 
But being a small team, our options are pretty limited.

Reception of FixFox from all of you has been amazing and warms my heart every day 💖
So I'm thinking, [b]would you like to help us translate FixFox into more languages?[/b] 🌐
We can't offer financial compensation, currently.

If so, please join FixFox Discord: 
[b][url=https://discord.gg/FixFox]https://discord.gg/FixFox[/url][/b]

We already got a nice set of contributors 💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41590840/6d830c11d4aae309083aec2f1803ff110b7eae19.png[/img]

notes.title: Savefile Saviour
notes.notes:
[b]TLDR:[/b] If your save files seemed to disappear, this update fixes the issue. Your savefiles are safe!

[b]Detailed explanation:[/b]
Your savefiles are supposed to be stored here:
Users\<USER>\AppData\LocalLow\Rendlike\FixFox\<STEAMUSERID>
The Summer Update build was, however, looking for files here:
Users\<USER>\AppData\LocalLow\Rendlike\FixFox\Vix

The current update:
- fixes the issue, looking into the correct folder. You should see your save files again.
- if you've just started playing the game, the game looks into [b]Vix[/b] directory and copies the files into the correct directory

Make sure to restart Steam after the update.

If you encounter any more issues, please contact me at [b]fixfoxgame@gmail.com[/b].

Sorry for your inconvenience!

notes.title: FixFox Developer Livestream
notes.notes:
Watch the developer livestream FixFox for Steam Next Fest and check out the game's demo. 

FixFox is a wholesome sci-fi adventure game. Play as Vix, an unlucky space mechanic, who crashlands on a mysterious planet where tools are forbidden. Accompanied by her trusty toolbox Tin, they travel across the planet Karamel discovering hidden stashes left by pirates, repairing friendly household appliances, and sampling tasty local delicacies.

If you've Wishlisted FixFox, thank you!
